apps.name: AppRec
apps.description: Mac menu bar app that records one app's audio plus your microphone, transcribes it on your Mac, writes a summary, and names the file after what was said.

apps.name: Sharefly
apps.description: Share an HTML, Markdown file or any file, from your terminal as a link. Works locally with zero setup, or publicly through a Cloudflare Tunnel, with optional password protection.

apps.name: BrokerSync
apps.description: Aggregates statements from a few supported brokers used in Romania and turns them into statistics: positions, P&L, dividends, and performance per broker.

apps.name: Watchlist
apps.description: Add companies to a watchlist and track their price, charts, and financial data in one place.

apps.name: Wealth Me
apps.description: Self-hosted net worth tracker. Log savings, stocks, crypto, assets, and debts once a month, compare returns against the S&P 500, Nasdaq, and VWCE, and plan early retirement. One SQLite file on your machine, optionally encrypted.

apps.name: MeterSync
apps.description: Private, open-source desktop app for tracking electricity, gas, water, and custom utility meters, with charts and an encrypted local database. Nothing goes to the cloud.

apps.name: AnalyzeMe
apps.description: Upload blood test results, track biomarkers over time, and spot trends before they matter. Imports lab PDFs and CSVs. Private and local-first.

apps.name: go-finance
apps.description: Small Go library for real-time and historical stock, crypto, and currency prices from Yahoo Finance, with parallel quote and FX-rate fetching.
